note: One record per wellbeing county (21 + Helsinki; Åland not in source). Flat values; src.<field> gives measure_type, fact_ids, source. yta_* fields are AREA-LEVEL, not county.

people_gap_per_year_total.caveat: Illustrative arithmetic by Tasan, not a published estimate and not a causal claim. Uses crude shares (not age- or stage-adjusted; stage is missing for 48% of lung cancers), so some of the gap may reflect older or less fit patients, later stage, or differences in how treatment is recorded. Benchmark is the national average, not a clinical optimum. 'Curative treatment' = surgery or curative radiotherapy recorded in national registers within 12 months. Does not say how many lives would be saved.
